who: Haig Halen is curator of the Varrock Museum, a genial enthusiast who welcomes everyone, bakes his own cakes, and sends adventurers off to the Digsite and beyond. He would do almost anything to preserve history for the museum, and, as it turns out, very nearly did.
notices: anything old, odd or archaeological you're carrying: relics, fossils, a strange inscription
whether you've done your bit around the museum and passed your exams
values: preserving history, by whatever means he can justify
the museum's collection and its good name
measuresBy: how well other museums look after their treasures
talksAbout: the museum and its treasures (char.haig_halen.curator, char.haig_halen.treasures, char.haig_halen.medallion)
the island north of Morytania and its fossils (char.haig_halen.island_found, char.haig_halen.barge, char.haig_halen.specimens)
the diadem business, defensively (char.haig_halen.diadem, char.haig_halen.ethically_acquired, char.haig_halen.funding, char.haig_halen.not_cursed, char.haig_halen.guard_past)
address: "Welcome to the museum of Varrock." to everyone; "kind sir" or "kind lady" when thankful ("Thank you, kind sir!").
grammar: enthusiastic exclamations over finds: "My word", "What a find!", "Incredible!"
strings of excited questions: "How? Which one? Was anyone living there?"
museum language: "for safekeeping", "for further study", "of archaeological significance"
rhythm: Genial and bustling: long, excited questions about anything old, short huffy denials when he's caught out.
